intro: Work the story in order, finish the stranger strands before the finale wherever a trophy needs a partner or a character, then grind the counted sets in free roam. The 100% completion gold is the last gate before the platinum.

phases.blurb: Play the story straight through. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies pop as you go, and the final-mission gold closes the stage. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
phases.name: Story first

phases.blurb: Stranger strands open across Leonida. Finish Andy's, Billy's, Kenton's, Randy's and Tyrone's strands to their finales, and clear enough other strands for the 8-strand counter. Bret's hunting strand runs alongside.
phases.name: Strangers and side strands

phases.blurb: Skills and counted activities: stunts, the shooting ranges, drone races, the 20 race wins, fishing, the arcade, meditation, the 50 challenges, Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the tank, the jewelry job and the armored truck.
phases.name: Activities and skills

phases.blurb: Location hunts and sets: the 14 drone race spots, the 18 meditation spots, the 3 card sets, the 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, and all 52 areas of Leonida.
phases.name: Collectibles and exploration

phases.blurb: Money, mayhem and cleanup. Partner robberies, bank vaults, one operation per gang, the one-off story moments, the 500 choices, the laundering and spending goals, the garages, the Scooter Bros registrations — then 100% completion and the platinum.
phases.name: Money, mayhem and cleanup
